content.text:
是时候用一些运算符来提升我们的逻辑运算水平了。
 
逻辑运算符 **and**、**or**、**not** 允许在一个`if`语句中判断多个或者复杂条件。

让我们从 **and** 运算符开始。如果两个条件都是 "真"，那么它才是 "真"。
content.text_html:
Now it’s time to level up our Booleans with some operators!

The Boolean and, or, **not **operators allow to check for multiple conditions in an if statement.

Let’s start with the **and **operator. It is True, if both conditions evaluate to True:

现在，是时候用一些运算符来提升我们的布尔运算水平了

布尔运算符和、或、非允许在一个if语句中检查多个条件。

让我们从和运算符开始。如果两个条件都是 "真"，那么它就是 "真"。

content.content:
print( 1 == 1 and 2 == 2 )
# True
print( 1 == 1 and 2 == 3 )
# False
print( 1 != 1 and 2 == 2 )
# False
print( 2 < 1 and 3 >  6 )
# False

content.text: 逻辑运算符可以根据需要在表达式中使用多次。
content.text_html:
Boolean operators can be used in expression as many times as needed.

布尔运算符可以根据需要在表达式中使用多次。

resolved.title: 逻辑运算符 or
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Boolean Or[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Now onto the [b]or operator[/b].

The [b]or [/b]operator is [b]True[/b] if either (or both) of its conditions are [b]True[/b], and [b]False [/b]if both conditions are [b]False[/b].[code format="py" codeId="3912"]print( 1 == 1 [b]or[/b] 2 == 2 )
[b]True[/b]
print( 1 == 1 [b]or[/b] 2 == 3 )
[b]True[/b]
print( 1 != 1 [b]or[/b] 2 == 2 )
[b]True[/b]
print( 2 < 1 [b]or[/b] 3 >  6 )
[b]False[/b][/code]
Making sense? Great!
[note]Besides values, you can also compare variables.[/note]

[s0l0!-header][h1]Boolean Or[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Now onto the [b]or operator[/b].

The [b]or [/b]operator is [b]True[/b] if either (or both) of its conditions are [b]True[/b], and [b]False [/b]if both conditions are [b]False[/b].[code format="py" codeId="3912"]print( 1 == 1 [b]or[/b] 2 == 2 )

content.text:
现在来看看 **or**。

如果其中一个（或两个）条件是 **真** ，则 **or** 运算结果为 **真**，如果两个条件都是 **假** ，则结果为 **假**。
content.text_html:
Now onto the or operator.

The **or **operator is True if either (or both) of its conditions are True, and **False **if both conditions are False.

现在来看看或运算符。

如果其中一个（或两个）条件是真，则或运算符为真，如果两个条件都是假，则假**。

content.content:
print( 1 == 1 or 2 == 2 )
# True

print( 1 == 1 or 2 == 3 )
# True

print( 1 != 1 or 2 == 2 )
# True

print( 2 < 1 or 3 >  6 )
# False

content.text: 当然，除了数值，你还可以比较变量。
content.text_html:
Besides values, you can also compare variables.

除了数值，你还可以比较变量。

Finally, the [b]not operator[/b] works a little differently. [b]not [/b]takes just one argument, and inverts it. 

The result of [b]not True[/b] is [b]False[/b], and [b]not False[/b] goes to [b]True[/b]. Like this:[code format="py" codeId="3913"]print([b]not [/b]1 == 1)

resolved.title: 获取黄金K值
resolved.problem_statement_md:
前面我们学习了根据不同条件，判断黄金的纯度，这节课我们学习更复杂的逻辑判断。

以下是我们要使用的纯度表：
**24K** - 99.9%
**22K** - 91.7%
**20K** - 83.3%
**18K** - 75.0%

百分比在75和83.3之间，被认为是18K。
百分比在83.3和91.7之间，被认为是20K，以此类推。

给出百分比作为输入，输出相应的K值，包括字母**K**。
如果百分比低于75%，不输出任何东西。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Boolean Logic[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Now that we know how to combine multiple conditions, let’s improve our gold purity checker program and output the corresponding purity level in Karats!

Here is the purity chart we’ll be using:
[b]24K[/b] – 99.9%
[b]22K[/b] – 91.7%
[b]20K[/b] – 83.3%
[b]18K[/b] – 75.0%

If the percentage is between 75 and 83.3, the gold is considered to be 18K.
If it's between 83.3 and 91.7 - then it’s 20K, and so on. 

Given the percentage as input, output the corresponding Karat value, including the letter [b]K[/b]. 

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
92.4

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
22K

[note]Do not output anything, if the percentage is lower than 75%.[/note]
